text:
sara: Rooftop sprint + post-climb smoothie tonight? 8pm quick meetup, 20min sprint sets then chill/stretch and blends?
jon: Im in for the sprints but Ill bail on the smoothies if someone brings protein powder 95c
priya: I can bring almond milk + bananas. any dietary restrictions?
felix: allergic to cashews, please no cashew milk. allergic-to-foam kettle bell meme attached :joy:
sara: noted cashew-free. smoothie poll: react with :one: = protein shake, :two: = banana smoothie, :three: = green smoothie
jon: also FYI Im bringing a tiny speaker. playlist request: send songs here or DM me.
priya: low-key remix of "Eye of the Tiger" please.
felix: also who wants to borrow my lightweight resistance bands for warmups?
rachel: count me in for bands and some quick mobility drills. Ill lead 10m of dynamic warmups.
stretchi-bot: Reminder: 10-minute mobility flow added to channel pins.
dev-bot: Calendar event created 4c5 Rooftop Sprint & Smoothies 3c3 20:00-20:50 Link: https://calendar.redwood.work/event/2100109999
sara: safety note: rooftop has low railing on the north side. stay away from edge during sprint drills.
jon: good call. also masks optional, but please sanitize shoes before coming on the mat.
priya: brownie points for anyone who finishes 4 x 200m in under 1:15 each :muscle:
felix: Ill bring a tiny first-aid kit and some ice packs.
sara: cool. final checklist: banana+almond (priya), speaker+playlist (jon), bands (felix), mobility drills (rachel), protein powder (volunteer?), sanitizer+towels (anyone)
jon: Ill grab sanitizer and two small towels.
priya: can someone post the simple smoothie recipe so people know the plan?
sara: recipe (quick): 1 banana, 1 cup almond milk, 1 scoop protein, ice, 1 tbsp peanut butter (optional). blend 30s. also pre-portion cups in the kitchen fridge.
felix: meme: "me before sprints vs me after smoothies" attached :rofl:
rachel: see you all at 7:50pm by the elevator. please be on time so we can warm up properly.
